Sun+Moon.effect: Powerful — Sun burns Moon's emotions. Sharp, independent. Mother relation affected.
Sun+Moon.remedy: Offer water to Sun at sunrise on Mondays.

Sun+Mars.effect: Raja Yoga in Lal Kitab — government career, leadership, authority. Very powerful.
Sun+Mars.remedy: Light diya at Hanuman temple on Sundays.

Sun+Mercury.effect: Intelligent and authoritative. Career in administration or communication.
Sun+Mercury.remedy: Donate copper and green items together.

Sun+Jupiter.effect: Highly auspicious — wisdom and authority combined. Teacher or government officer.

Sun+Venus.effect: Venus weakens near Sun (combustion). Romance vs career conflict.
Sun+Venus.remedy: Donate white and copper items on Friday.

Sun+Saturn.effect: Father-son conflict energy. Career delays. Service under authority.
Sun+Saturn.remedy: Respect father figure. Donate iron and copper together.

Sun+Rahu.effect: Grahan yoga — eclipse of self. Government troubles. Foreign connections.
Sun+Rahu.remedy: Offer coconut in river on Sundays.

Sun+Ketu.effect: Spiritual authority. Past life government karma. Detachment from ego.

Moon+Mars.effect: Emotional warrior. Property gains but mother-land conflict.

Moon+Mercury.effect: Sharp mind and emotions combined. Good for business and public life.
Moon+Mercury.remedy: Feed silver fish to water birds.

Moon+Jupiter.effect: Gaja Kesari in Lal Kitab — wealth, wisdom, good family.

Moon+Venus.effect: Beautiful nature, artistic, wealth from female connections.
Moon+Venus.remedy: Offer rose water to Goddess on Fridays.

Moon+Saturn.effect: Emotional delays. Depression possible. Hard-earned home and family.
Moon+Saturn.remedy: Feed crows milk-soaked bread on Saturdays.

Moon+Rahu.effect: Mind turbulence, unusual mother, foreign emotional connections.
Moon+Rahu.remedy: Keep silver in water overnight, then drink that water.

Moon+Ketu.effect: Spiritual emotions. Past life mother karma. Detachment from home.
Moon+Ketu.remedy: Worship Goddess Durga on full moon.

Mars+Jupiter.effect: Auspicious for property and wealth. Brave and wise combination.
Mars+Jupiter.remedy: Donate to soldiers' families on Thursdays.

Mars+Saturn.effect: Conflict between action and delay. Property disputes. Hard work.
Mars+Saturn.remedy: Bury iron and copper together in own land.

Rahu+Ketu.effect: Always in opposition — karmic axis. Spiritual struggles and worldly desires.
Rahu+Ketu.remedy: Worship on both Tuesdays and Saturdays.
